notes: 🧰 New: GlowHarness, an agent harness we built from scratch. It lets an AI use tools, shows every step, and asks before it saves, deletes or downloads anything
It works with no AI model at all for sums, dates, units, text and notes, so nothing leaves the page. Switch to a free model for other questions
Replay any run, save its record, and re-run the engine's own checks in your browser
The page shows its measured results on our own small test set, with and without the harness, and says where Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode are better
Find it on Glow home, in the Glow apps menu, or type a task and choose 🧰 Agent
